name: HostDeFi Token Risk API
description: Machine-payable token-safety intelligence for AI agents: A+-F risk verdicts, pre-graduation Solana signals, authority checks, wallet portfolio audits and a trend-radar feed. Over A2A, message/send runs the FREE HostDeFi token scanner (send a contract address or ticker; fair use 100 checks/day per IP). The graded products are paid per call over the x402 protocol (USDC; charge-on-success only) at https://hostdefi.com/api/v1/x402/pricing or via the hosted MCP server at https://hostdefi.com/api/v1/mcp - no key, no account. API keys purchasable in one x402 payment for volume.

skills.name: Free token safety scan (A2A message/send)
skills.description: Send a Solana mint, an EVM 0x address, or an exact token name/ticker in a text or data part; the task completes with the free scanner's structured risk read (authority state, liquidity, holder concentration, contract flags) as a data-part artifact. No payment.

skills.name: Token safety verdict
skills.description: A+-F grade, score and verdict prose for a token by chain + address, or by free-form query resolved to the top-liquidity match. Solana and major EVM chains (paid via x402 HTTP or the MCP tools, not over A2A).

skills.name: Pre-graduation Solana signals
skills.description: Bundled-launch detection, curve-aware holder concentration, Token-2022 trap flags and authority state for early Solana mints (paid via x402 HTTP or the MCP tools, not over A2A).

skills.name: Wallet portfolio audit
skills.description: Risk-graded verdicts for a Solana wallet's largest token holdings (up to 10) in one call (paid via x402 HTTP or the MCP tools, not over A2A).

skills.name: Trend-radar alerts
skills.description: Recent big dated movers with real market cap, as structured JSON (paid via x402 HTTP or the MCP tools, not over A2A).

skills.name: Safety datasets and listings
skills.description: Dated weekly snapshot data in bulk: graded token listings per chain (Solana + major EVM), the rug/collapse gate-exit ledger, radar alert history, and the full safety-snapshot dataset in one call (paid via x402 HTTP or the MCP tools, not over A2A).

skills.name: x402 provider-risk grades
skills.description: Vet an x402 seller before paying it: A-F grades from observable signals (402-spec fidelity, price sanity, payTo presence, TLS, latency, reachability) for crawled x402 resources and providers, as a dated snapshot (paid via x402 HTTP or the MCP tools, not over A2A).
